title: Japanese Almond Milk Dessert
description: A unique Japanese dessert that combines almond milk with a light and airy texture. Perfect for warm days or as a sweet treat.
instructions: 1. In a bowl, whisk together almond milk and light until well combined.
2. In a separate bowl, whip the almond until it forms a light and airy mixture.
3. Fold the whipped almond into the almond milk mixture until well combined.
4. Pour the mixture into individual bowls and chill in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes.
5. Serve the Japanese almond milk dessert chilled and garnish with additional almond if desired.
